Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
Once an order is placed, we are unable to add or remove items, or cancel it directly, as it immediately enters our processing queue. Orders typically take 3 to 7 business days to process before shipping.
If your order has already processed or shipped, you can simply refuse the package upon delivery. Once the tracking details confirm it is being returned to us, please let our team know and we'll be happy to assist you further.

Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
No, we are strictly unable to add items to an existing order once it has been placed.
